description:
The ten pointwise grade stages (9 black point, 10 white point,
11 shadows, 12 midtones, 13 contrast, 16 temperature, 17 tint,
18 color wheel, 19 split tone, 20 saturation) crossed both GPU
seams, so a multi-control grade stays on GPU end to end instead
of falling back to CPU per control.

Native layer: both request structs (DevelopFrameRequest,
PreviewFrameRequest) gain the 18 raw grade values (17 floats +
asShot) with GradeK's own defaults (tempK 5600, split hues -1,
asShot true); both Impl loc chains gain the 19 uniforms
(uBlackPoint..uSaturation plus the two hoisted int gates
uWbManual/uSplitActive); both lookup blocks extend the
shader-contract check; both passes compute the CPU-side gates
exactly like the shading gate (wbManual = !asShot,
splitActive = a split hue >= 0) and bind the 19 uniforms between
highlights and tonemap.
